scope: Matched-768 schema comparisons only; original-study logs and smoke tests are outside these tables.
selection_policy: Use only table_cells.selected_path; never glob or concatenate all result folders.
Each selected cell is one complete run with 150 unique cases, the specified schema, a 32-token cap, matching images/questions/truth/system prompt and a verified source snapshot.
Cutoffs and invalid answers remain failures in the 150-case denominator; HTTP-failed attempts remain separate audit records.
Reasoning controls remain separate metadata: identical answer format does not establish equal reasoning or provider preprocessing.
This is a snapshot. Verify selected JSONL hashes before generating tables; refresh incomplete entries explicitly rather than silently promoting them.
For newly added models, select the earliest complete verified run for each format, not the highest score; requested new6 repeats remain separately identifiable by folder.
